plainTranslation: A's drive meets B's growth. The trine lets them flow together easily.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper work smoothly with your judgment about what's possible. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The challenge is that things come so easily between you that you may not push yourselves to use the gift. It feels good to believe in what is possible. It is another thing to actually commit to it.
advice: This connection offers confidence. The invitation is to do something with it. Potential is not the same as movement. Let the encouragement land. Take the step. Trust yourself enough to begin.
